feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Democrats and Republicans can agree: there should be more monetary support for child care
entry.summary: The Trump administration is eyeing a proposal to give childcare subsidies to married couples with a stay-at-home parent. Some Democrats have a similar proposal, with one major difference.

entry.title: President Trump to meet with Irish president and prime minister
entry.summary: President Trump is working in some Irish diplomacy as he attends a golf tournament at his club in Doonbeg.

entry.title: Week in politics: Trump attends Republican midterm convention and Pentagon's 9/11 memorial service
entry.summary: President Trump attended a 9/11 memorial service at the Pentagon on Friday after speaking on both nights of a Republican gathering in Dallas.

entry.title: Neighbor turned on neighbor after Charlie Kirk's killing. Is the divide here to stay?
entry.summary: The assassination of far right activist Charlie Kirk opened the floodgates of neighbor-on-neighbor doxing. A year later, the damage to political discourse in the U.S. remains.

entry.title: Ethics watchdogs await RFK Jr.'s financial report
entry.summary: Health Secretary RFK Jr.'s annual financial disclosure is late. When it posts, the public could learn how much he has earned from a vaccine-related lawsuit against Merck, which RFK now regulates.

entry.title: Mayor of the 'Air Capital of the World' reacts to Trump's threats against Bombardier
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Wichita Mayor Lily Wu about President Trump's tariff war with Canada, Bombardier aircrafts, and the trade war's potential impact on her city.

entry.title: Trump heads to Ireland to watch some golf at his club and conduct some diplomacy
entry.summary: President Trump heads to Ireland hoping for a little diplomacy as he watches a tournament at his golf club in Doonbeg.

entry.title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
entry.summary: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

entry.title: Empty seats, socialism and Trump dominate the Republican midterm convention
entry.summary: The two day Republican convention in Dallas showcased the party's biggest asset in trying to win competitive midterm races and its greatest obstacle: President Trump.

entry.title: These Michigan swing voters are bracing for higher prices from trade war with Canada
entry.summary: President Trump's tariff standoff with Canada is rankling some key voters ahead of this year's midterm elections.
